notes: BFE now shows up in other apps' "Open with" menus for every archive, disc image and installer it can extract — ISO, BIN, WCP, tar, gz, xz, bz2, zst, cab, dmg, deb, rpm, setup .exe and more. Files handed over from another app now open properly in the extractor; if that app hides where the file is stored, BFE copies it in first and removes the copy once it's extracted. Opening a plain program .exe now tells you there's nothing inside to unpack.
